paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -2.38% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (-1.00%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-5.06%). Brent crude changed -2.95% to 89.27. Gold changed -3.13% to 3,570.2. Bitcoin changed -0.77% to 61,422.8789. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.052%, a relative move of -0.28%. Among the firms tracked, EQT (-4.63%) and Lazard (-4.57%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: UniCredit agrees deal with Berlin on Commerzbank takeover (FT World). Move clears major obstacle for Italian lender to take control of Germany’s second-largest bank after two-year battle Deals and capital markets: FirstFT: Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO raises record $81bn (FT Markets). Also in today’s newsletter: Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral Central banks and macro: Oil loses grip on bond markets as inflation ‘virus’ spreads (FT World). Tight correlation between crude prices and borrowing costs has broken down Central banks and macro: Brazil’s central bank steps in to stem real’s slide since Lula’s re-election (FT Markets). Currency has slipped from R$5 to R$5.90 to the dollar following leftwinger’s victory last month Geopolitics and trade: Gulf flare-up stokes fears of return to Iran war (FT World). A week of tit-for-tat escalation by Iran and the US has brought the countries closer to another full-scale confrontation, analysts say Geopolitics and trade: Putin invites European leaders to Moscow for talks on Ukraine (FT World). Russian leader signals he is unwilling to relax hardline demands for ending war
